scope: public synthetic disposable fake ships; not browser or live authentication

mutation.payload: raw UTF-8 command JSON cord; maximum 65536 bytes
mutation.authoritative_context: src.bowl resolved against current fixture binding; no caller actor

result.delivery: one exact-path fact then kick, final authority rechecked; ACK alone is not success
result.expiry_cleanup: lazy on a later watch or poke; no timer

read_delivery: current authenticated request duct only; one fact then kick; no ongoing content subscription

fixture_initialization.source: owner-local administration on disposable zod, empty product state only

git_export: Authorized current-ref manifest plus individual object reads, each reauthorized and proven reachable from the named retained snapshot in this container
resource_identity: typed scoped tuple; local UUID alone is not complete identity

receipt.container_id: document container UUID or empty string
receipt.scope: policy is a distinct project-policy resource; its revision is visible only to an authorized policy actor

compatibility.stead-command-2: command/2 new or retry; command/1 replay-only
compatibility.stead-command-1: command/1 replay-only; command/2 rejected as mismatched mark
compatibility.result: all outcomes use stead-result-2; reads and result reservations use /v2
compatibility.unaccepted_legacy: current authority/epoch checked first, then unsupported_version; no accepted state change
